name: Freytag’s Pyramid
axiom: A story earns its turn by building pressure, then releasing it.
trigger: Explaining a product lifecycle, a multi-year transformation, or any change with an unavoidable peak of pressure.

steps.text: Exposition: establish who is involved and what is at stake.
Rising action: each attempt raises the cost of failing.
Climax: the decision that cannot be taken back.
Falling action: consequences arrive faster than remedies.
Denouement: the new baseline, stated plainly.

antiPattern.violation: A flat retelling that lists events in order but never raises the stakes, so the climax arrives with nothing behind it.
antiPattern.remediation: Name the pressure at every beat. If two beats raise the same pressure, one of them is filler.

prompt: The peak our audience cannot skip past is ______.
